union.summary: Todo checklist leaves several steps unchecked even though the diff shows them completed
union.evidence: The steps list has '- [ ] Add `packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts`', '- [ ] Wire it into `preview.ts`', '- [ ] Unit tests in `preview.test.ts` ...', '- [ ] Note the deviation in `docs/design/notes/notes.md`' all marked unchecked, but the diff in this same PR adds `list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts`, wires it into `preview.ts`, adds the described tests to `preview.test.ts`, and adds the deviation note to `docs/design/notes/notes.md`. A reader of the task file would be misled into thinking this work is still outstanding.
